notes.title: 1.2.2 Patchnote and FUTURE OF MURKY DIVERS
notes.content:
Murky Divers – Patch 1.2.2
ATTENTION RECRUITS!

This update is mostly focused on tightening the screws and cleaning up some of the darker corners of the abyss. Here’s what’s been fixed in version 1.2.2:

Fixed several lag spikes caused by enemy navigation, especially for hosts.

Fixed the challenges that were randomized each game instead of being consistent for the current week.

Fixed an issue where respawn would fail when launching an expedition with the Mine Curse active.

Smoothed the end of the expedition transition for the player using the lever.

Thanks for all the bug reports and feedback, it helps more than you think!


What lies Beneath
We're brewing something weird and wonderful for Update 1.3, coming October 2025...

You’ve been collecting all those body parts, but did you ever wonder if they’re collecting something back?

Next update, expect more surprises when handling the remains of the deep. Some of them might whisper. Some might scream. Some might... do other things.

Stay curious, and maybe keep one hand free.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/e37372361d48ae1f576b9a0fc463d2b508736f8c.jpg"]

notes.title: 🚨MAJOR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE
notes.content:
ATTENTION RECRUITS!

As we mark one year since the inception of Operation: Murky Divers, over 600,000 of you have bravely plunged into the depths to ensure PharmaCorps' operations run as smoothly as possible.

To commemorate this milestone, PharmaCorps is proud to unveil the ✨1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE✨, now available for all divers.

[previewyoutube="EQHj10sgcPI;full"][/previewyoutube]

What's New in This Update:
New Biome - Apothec Corps: A limb to the past. To celebrate the anniversary of your favorite company, Pharma invites you to delve into the origins of its creation, when the company was nothing more than an itinerant apothecary store with somewhat avant-garde illegal practices. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/19f9240fdc2b1013ff7aa64f9f44d2f1e54553eb.jpg"]

Two New Lifeforms: Our labs have detected two previously unknown entities. Classification is pending, but early observations indicate they're... lively.

Big Mama & her little Fellas: A devoted mother who takes care of her small group of tadpole offspring. Careful, we lack information about their behavior

🌛Selfish Moon Emerges: A celestial sibling to the infamous Selfish Sun has been spotted. Preliminary tests show heightened instability and... pretentiousness? Divers are advised to keep their distance, and their prayers handy.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/a411ac2f6d275af79474f59273048c2860f5ae55.png"]

New Curses: A myserious life form found in hidden expedition sites can now grant you 4 new curses on top of the 3 existing ones. They offer greater rewards but also greater risks! 

Core Gameplay Improvements:

Shopping Carts Standardized: No more tears over lost carts. They now respawn between expeditions and are limited to three per team. In a rare act of corporate generosity, PharmaCorps is providing your first cart free of charge, always ready, always loyal.

Scooter Enhancements: Now upgraded with a stylish new basket, the scooter can act as a miniature cart and is easier to control. However, it’s still prone to... unfortunate disappearances. Treat it kindly.

Depth Station Expanded: The Depth Station now allows you to select your next biome after each expedition. Battery usage to dive deeper is now independent of that choice. Efficiency meets flexibility.

Smarter Creature Spawns: Creatures now appear deeper within expedition sites, giving you a little breathing room during your initial descent. Probably.

Item Cost Rebalancing: Several item prices in the dispenser have been adjusted. Some went down. Others didn’t.

🛠️Bug Fixes and Improvements: Our engineers have addressed several issues to enhance your underwater experience. Remember, a smoother dive is a happier dive.  


Tutorial Facility Now Operational:
A dedicated new PharmaCorps training center has opened its reinforced blast doors! This immersive tutorial facility will teach you the basics of murky diving, safely, effectively, and with minimal trauma.

Complete it to earn your official diving certificate and unlock a new skin.
Available when launching the game for the first time, or accessible anytime from the main menu.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/6518672dfcf9d2003f0549a12cb1c589248b6ab9.png"]
Diver Plushie Initiative:
You asked. We listened. PharmaCorps is exploring the creation of official diver plushies! 

Simply follow this link and register your interest. 

If enough of you back the project, cuddly corporate compliance will become a reality.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/8de84b8b92decac59f107ca1a0f5b5bbc9315a42.png"]

Your unwavering compliance, adaptability, and ability to scream underwater continue to be the cornerstones of our success.



Sincerely,



Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨MAJOR ANNIVERSARY UPDATE COMING IN JUNE
notes.content:
Attention recruits,

It’s hard to believe, but we’re coming up on one whole year of operations with more than ✨600k of you✨, and what a journey it’s been.

Update in the works
To commemorate, PharmaCorps has been quietly working behind the scenes for a Major Anniversary Update. While full access to classified details remains restricted, we are authorized to share the following intel:

 A previously uncharted Biome has been flagged for exploration
 Two new lifeforms have been identified and require field observation (please avoid petting)
 ███ ████: group of several creatures, at first sight harmless, to be confirmed 

 🌛 Selfish Moon: sibling of the Selfish Sun found in Atlantis, our initial tests show far greater instability and █████████
 New curse and trade agreements have been established
 🛠️ Bugfixes and improvements will help your work

As always, your compliance, adaptability, and ability to scream underwater are greatly appreciated.

600.000 Divers!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/dec74e0a18cd0c9c61dd8cc0e2ce3667504d03c9.jpg
As of this quarter, our recruitment program has successfully onboarded over 600,000 Divers into active deployment. That’s over half a million individuals committed to pushing the boundaries of exploration, research, and mildly experimental procedures. Your dedication [strike](fills us with gratitude)[/strike] has been... statistically remarkable.

We’re excited to keep building the glory of PharmaCorps with you 🏆. We’ll be sharing more details soon. Until then, continue your assigned duties, report any unusual encounters, and remember:

PharmaCorps sees you. PharmaCorps thanks you. PharmaCorps care.

notes.title: 🚨 Major update 1.1 | Mod Support & Challenge Mode
notes.content:
Attention recruits, 

The wait is finally over... MOD SUPPORT IS HERE! 

Pharma Corps' technical department has worked tirelessly over the past few weeks, pushing the limits of what’s possible. Just yesterday, they informed management that their latest advancements are finally complete. After rigorous testing (and an acceptable number of unforeseen incidents), we are now ready to deploy these new features into the field. Recruits, prepare yourselves. A new era of operations begins now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/7d4a7c6bf0410c967fa8b1b43a083f5eafc29c5c.jpg

MOD SUPPORT
Pharma Corps is eagerly awaiting the incredible, boundary-pushing creations you will develop. The sky is truly the limit—whether it's ingenious tools, unsettling new discoveries, or... unexpected anomalies. At Pharma Corps, we have always been strong advocates for creativity, and we take great pride in stimulating and supporting innovative minds like yours. After all, creativity is the cornerstone of society—without it, life would be unbearably dull. So go forth, experiment, and bring your wildest ideas to life. We can’t wait to see what you create… and how it might change everything.

PS: Modders can receive a special modder role on our Discord! 

CHALLENGE MODE
Recruits, it’s time to put your efficiency to the test. Introducing Challenge Mode—a high-stakes, high-reward operation where your mission is simple: grab as much money as possible before time runs out. Dive into a sprawling megacomplex, shred body parts to extend your timer, and push your crew to its limits. Only the most ruthless and resourceful will carve their names into the top 10 crews.

The expedition site is a fixed XXL-level, shifting weekly to keep things… interesting. And to help you navigate the chaos, we’re introducing spray paint—mark your path, leave warnings, or just express yourself in ways Pharma Corps will definitely not be held responsible for.

So—are you up for the challenge? Or will the megacomplex claim you like so many before?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/afdd4fde58fd28fb64389838e3469746b9e8fe38.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/e5a9f77358fc18be2a936fcb4da067bc1b753c28.png

500.000 divers
Pharma Corps has officially reached 500,000 divers! That’s half a million brave souls venturing into the depths, pushing the limits, and ensuring our operations run as smoothly as possible. Your dedication does not go unnoticed (even if your predecessors sometimes do). But remember, there’s still plenty of work to be done, and the ocean isn’t getting any safer. So gear up, stay efficient, and let’s see what the next 500,000 can accomplish. Onward.

What's next?
Rest assured, Pharma Corps is not yet done. Our internal development team is actively working on more content which shall become available to all divers around June. Aside from content, a surprise awaits around that period. More information will follow! 

THANK YOU
We extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you for being part of this journey. From the depths of the unknown to the cutting edge of innovation, your dedication has driven us forward. Whether you’re a seasoned diver or a fresh recruit, your efforts are what make this mission possible. So here’s to the challenges faced, the discoveries made, and the countless adventures still ahead. Thank you for being part of the Pharma Corps family!

Sincerely,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨 Happy Spring Festival 🎆
notes.content:
Attention Recruits,

The holiday season may be behind us, but the celebrations are far from over! Christmas and New Year’s have come and gone, but now it’s time to embrace the festivities of the Spring Festival.

As an international company, Pharma Corps takes pride in celebrating local traditions from around the globe—because no matter where you dive, there’s always something to commemorate.

Here’s what you can expect:

Spring Festival Theme

Decorations
Just like our Halloween and Christmas events, there will be new interiors for all three submarines, now brimming with Spring Festival decor. The Spring Festival theme will be available for a limited time, and you'll be able to toggle it in custom games.

New Emote
The classic "Emote 2" has been replaced with a festive Chinese-themed emote.

Lion Dance
The Sea Monkey suit has been transformed into a stunning Dance Lion suit, bringing a traditional flair to your dives.

Themed Economy
Price tags on body parts now feature red envelope skins, and in-game currency shifts from dollars to yuan, embracing the holiday spirit.

What's next for Murky Divers?

The depths hold endless possibilities, and there’s so much more to explore. A new update is on the horizon, and it’s bringing some of the most requested features from our amazing community.

Mod Support
Get ready to take customization to the next level, modding will give you the tools to shape your Murky Divers experience.

Challenge Mode
Think you’ve mastered the depths? Think again. This new mode will test your skills with unique scenarios and escalating difficulties.

Once again we want to emphasize that Pharma Corps is calling for all creative/technical masterminds with modding experience who want to receive exclusive early access to join the Discord!

---

Get ready to dive into the festivities with Murky Divers—and stay tuned for the exciting update coming soon!

Sincerely,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: ⚙️ Murky 1.0 patch notes 🔧
notes.content:

Fixes


 Crashes: We fixed an error that could occur in random cases after a few minutes when players share data with others, causing a crash

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨 MURKY DIVERS 1.0 | OUT NOW🚨
notes.content:
Attention Recruits,

Today marks an extraordinary day for Pharma Corps. Roughly six months ago, we unveiled Murky Divers to the world—a call for brave divers. 

After a few... let's call them unsuccessful experiments, the ocean became a bit of a liability. We needed elite divers to clean up our mess, discretely remove evidence, and, most importantly, ensure that none of our little “accidents” were discovered by the authorities. Your bravery, skill, and discretion have been invaluable.

With the success we’ve been seeing, Pharma Corps knew it was time to escalate operations. Early Access was merely a test run—a controlled experiment. Now, the real work begins, and the stakes have never been higher. Welcome to the 1.0. 

🎥 Launch Trailer

Diving in for the first time? Check out our Launch Trailer below!

[previewyoutube=nuE-R7O0Zpk;full][/previewyoutube]

 NEW Game Content

Murky Divers has received a wealth of feedback and suggestions during Early Access, and we’ve taken it all to heart. Here at Pharma Corps, we pride ourselves on listening to our team, which is why we’ve been nominated for Best Employer (in the “Underwater, Shady Experimentation” category) for 10 consecutive years. Your input has been instrumental in refining our operations—after all, a successful mission is built on collaboration.

Fully Customizable Servers
Infinite possibilities await beneath the waves. We’re thrilled to announce fully customizable server options for those who demand complete control over their dives. Tailor your Murky Divers experience to your exact preferences—from a lighter, more relaxed approach to the most extreme, hardcore challenges the ocean has to offer.

By default, settings are locked on Normal, letting you jump straight into the action by simply clicking "Confirm," just like before. But for those seeking something truly unique, the ocean is yours to command. Dive your way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/649773ddfecc8022c479f4076a829bd19ef78116.png

Just want to hop in and play? We’ve got you covered with three handy presets—Easy, Normal, and Hard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/e010cf4da57feb85a78c76b58d58bd677ccee0ff.png

Each preset includes a brief description of what to expect, making it easy to find the right challenge level. If you want something more tailored, you can either start with a preset and tweak the settings or dive straight into Custom mode. The choice is yours!

Improved Hosting

We’ve made significant upgrades to enhance the flow and clarity of the host menus, ensuring a smoother experience for divers setting up their adventures. Let’s dive into what’s new:

Hosting a game is now streamlined into clear, intuitive steps:
[olist]
 Choose your save file and set your game to public or private.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/eaca34f37fbf74952be616a9c3486d267d78a606.png
 If starting a new save, select your submarine size.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/cc1012e927495028f8a990ce0f6a42749d8265ec.png
 Customize your server settings—or jump right in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/e010cf4da57feb85a78c76b58d58bd677ccee0ff.png
[/olist]
The Laboratories

Pharma Corps’ darkest secret brings Murky Divers back to its essence: the eerie wreckage and haunting depths that started it all. Hidden within a biome reminiscent of the original wrecks lies the Diver Creation Facility, the birthplace of Pharma Corps’ elite divers. 

This once-vital site fell to ruin due to the company’s insatiable [strike]greed[/strike] ambition, imprisoning Atlantis’ aliens as mere decorations in executive aquariums. The aliens eventually broke free, unleashing chaos as they took control of the divers in production, slaughtered the staff, and transformed into the sinister copycat creatures now lurking in the shadows. 

Pharma Corps anticipated that some secrets might prove too dangerous to contain. To safeguard the integrity of its operations, a self-destruct mechanism was installed within the Diver Creation Facility—a last-resort measure to erase all evidence should the unimaginable occur.

Some say this is Pharma Corps' scariest biome so far.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/db2723c313280bacd4412fd4424cb5fac4b7a5d1.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/b7dc65b88d615556f0081ee795b09eeebd968169.png

New Creature: The Copy Cat

Introducing a new threat lurking in the depths—something that mirrors you, yet isn’t quite right. At first glance, it seems like just another diver, but appearances can be deceiving. This creature has a way of blending in, mimicking players with unsettling precision. It moves like you, acts like you, and even sounds like you. But something is off. What happens when you get too close?

Stay alert, trust nothing, and remember: not everything in the deep is what it seems.

Disclaimer: Do not be alarmed when you hear your voice. This was made possible with a custom tool that detects and records player voices and replicates them using an AI-generated voice. No data is stored beyond game sessions. All data is deleted when leaving the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/1066a561333ed235dff09584dcc24c1068406163.png

New Creature: The Baby Puker

There’s a strange creature that only appears in the tunnels—seemingly harmless at first, almost... cute. But don’t be fooled. Get too close, and you’ll find out just how dangerous it can be.

Just be careful where you step, especially when you're with friends. The tunnels have a way of hiding their true threats.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/ab6b4dfadb9053be6eef7ef1688cb168eb12c5f2.png

New Outfits

At Pharma Corps, we believe in empowering our divers to choose their own style and approach to every mission. 

 Diver Scientist: Step into the role of a Pharma Corps elite with this sleek suit, complete with a custom emote. Perfect for those who want to embody the corporate spirit while exploring the depths on behalf of the company.
 Cleaner: As part of our ongoing commitment to environmental stewardship, the Cleaner suit is built for those tasked with keeping the ocean free of debris. Whether you're collecting waste or maintaining order, this suit ensures you're always prepared for the job.
 Pharma Claus: In the spirit of seasonal generosity (and corporate goodwill), the Santa Claus suit is available for a limited time. Perfect for bringing some holiday cheer to your underwater missions, this suit ensures you’re always ready to spread Pharma Corps-approved festive spirit.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/a3e6084e3e8df2bbe74bf57d7908fb5137995c28.png

Holiday Festivities - It's Christmas!

This Christmas, Pharma Corps is bringing some holiday cheer to the depths! Submarines will be decked out in festive decorations, complete with sparkling lights, tinsel, and snowflakes drifting through the air. The atmosphere will be filled with the warmth and wonder of the season, even as you explore the cold, dark ocean.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/48fe1ad0c08146bd77d15da4314a37703c674026.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/63eab677442e79c91aa0d631d551dab4b6d92700.png

FOV Slider
We've added Murky Divers' most requested feature: the FOV slider: Divers are now able to tweak their field of view reducing potential motion sickness. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/c480b939b254b3811fba32ad9c522efb42cfe56e.png

Improvements
Pharma Corps is continually refining Murky Divers to enhance your experience. Here’s what’s new in the latest update:


 Black-out Effect: A new black-out effect has been added when you reach 0 oxygen, amplifying the tension and the thrill of managing your resources underwater.
 QR Code for Discord: Stay connected with the Murky Divers community! We’ve added a QR code in the game's main menu and in all submarines that lets you easily join our Discord and stay up-to-date on the latest news, updates, and discussions.
 Outfit Rarities: Outfits are now presented with rarities in the washing machine (Common, Rare, Legendary), making it easier to track your collection and show off your most prized pieces.
 Progress is now saved when leaving the game
 Ukrainian is now supported


Bugfixes

 Fixed submarine net not working in the big submarine
 Fixed several ending mugshot bugs with poses and positions
 Fixed the duck growing in scale after each save
 Fixed focus loss with controller after an error message
 Fixed several sound issues between upper and lower decks in the big submarine
 Fixed small behaviour bugs of the Selfish Sun
 Progress towards time diver and flusher outfits are now correctly tracked
 Pumpkins shredded from a cart are now counted for the Pumpking outfit
 Fixed Gobbler sometimes puking divers through the ground
 Fixed Gobbler death that was not releasing the diver in its belly
 Chameleon Gobbler is now correctly stunned after puking a diver
 Fixed offset sometimes happening on divers bodies
 Fixed Giant swimming through the Black Market
 Fixed dispenser sometimes spawning items under the ground
 Fixed ink from Chinken never disappearing if it died
 Fixed Grab module VFX replaying
 Fixed display of games in join game menu
 Fixed biome name display on depth station
 Fixed previous creatures sounds persisting when changing depth in navigation
 Fixed the kibble not being deleted from the cart when expiring
 Fixed texts overflowing in some languages

Call for talented modders
Our intelligence department is aware of the extreme desire for mod support. We can officially confirm that mod support will be available in the next update. We want to deliver the best possible mod support for Murky Divers. For that, we need experienced modders. Which leads us to...

Pharma Corps is calling for all creative/technical masterminds with modding experience who want to receive exclusive early access to join the Discord!

----

Once again, Pharma Corps would like to thank all of its brave divers for their continued commitment. The tides will always shift, but the mission of Pharma Corps remains steadfast. Let's get to work! 

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨 Major update 0.9 | Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
Hi recruits, 

Pharma Corps listened to your feedback (we have eyes and ears everywhere), 

That is why we are bringing a patch today to improve the balancing of the game and fix the outfit progress bug.

Bribe Donuts
Divers now get more money as batteries are free, that said we heard that Bribe is too expensive. Even though inflation kicked in, we will do our best to lower the price of the Bribe which suffered a lot.

New prices will be :

 Small submarine for up to 2 divers: 1200 -> 600
 Regular submarine for up to 4 divers: 1400 -> 750
 Large submarine for up to 8 divers: 1600 -> 900

Crocsaw
Endless chasing from this monstruosity can be tiring, sometimes at the cost of a few lives even. We are lowering its movement speed. This way it should stay dangerous in close quarters but easier to flee from.

Outfit unlocking progress
We noticed that progress for the new outfits wasn't always saving for players. It will now register properly and we added a save to your progress when you exit the game. Previously this was only at the end of an expedition.

We love your feedback
We are aware that Major Update 0.9 introduced some significant changes to Murky Divers. Even though we test everything internally thoroughly, we attach great value to you feedback! Pharma Corps Human Resource Department welcomes constructive feedback to improve the diving experience. Know that our intelligence department reads every review and forum post. 

Happy diving! 

Sincerely,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨MAJOR Update 0.9 | Halloween is here!🎃
notes.content:
Attention Recruits, 

Welcome to the final chapter of our three-part update series. Introducing the Halloween major update. This chapter packs a punch.

But first of all, Pharma Corps would like to extend its gratitude to the more than 280,000 divers! Your commitment and bravery have been essential in our mission, but there’s still plenty of evidence lurking in the depths that needs to be removed. We are excited to welcome new recruits as we continue to expand our ranks and tackle these challenges together. Thank you for being an integral part of the Pharma Corps family!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/4ebb2c9968a3be14191911933e8473a453d08f21.jpg

Halloween 🎃
Pharma Corps has given your submarines a seasonal upgrade. We've decorated your working environment for Halloween—expect ghost sightings, lots of skulls, pumpkins, and candles, and more unsettling surprises around every corner. Enjoy the festive atmosphere, but remember, the dangers lurking in the deep haven’t taken a holiday.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/1382f3479b6c87088ef2f744a34796c199f6a103.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/8cf3a7d5c750029876883ba5dfe8b64cb0ce533a.png

NEW BIOME - The Forgotten City
Pharma Corps is reopening access to a long-lost site—Atlantis, the Forgotten City. We discovered the ruins of this ancient civilization years ago and, seeing its potential, set up experimental labs throughout its submerged halls and temples. Unfortunately, things didn't go as planned, and our operations went dark after… *unforeseen complications.* Now, Atlantis lies in decay, its once-grand structures overtaken by the ocean, with traces of our failed experiments haunting its waters. Tread carefully, recruits—Atlantis is packed with traps and holds secrets and dangers that even we couldn’t contain.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/2daf50abbe74b70eefe7da45e119d6ffe250ecb9.png

Infinite Depths
Gone are the days of maximum depth limits—now, you can plunge infinitely into the abyss. The way depth works has been completely redesigned. Divers will now use a touch screen displaying a vertical depth meter and a next zone choice.

The depth meter is where you can track your submarine’s current depth and check how close the Police Squadron is. The threat level is indicated by three danger levels: green (you're far enough), orange (Police are getting closer), and red (Police are nearly on you—BIG danger). Upgrading the station to go deeper will help you put some distance between you and the pursuing squadron!

The Next Zone Choice system is meant to push your diving strategy even further. Each biome is now split into levels from 1 to 5, with higher levels bringing tougher challenges, more dangerous terrain, and deadlier creatures. You’ll see your current zone and the amount of energy needed to go deeper. Fill the energy bar using batteries found during expeditions or at the Black Market, and you’ll get to choose between two zones for your next dive. Once you make your choice, the submarine descends, and a new energy bar appears, demanding more power for each deeper step.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/183228cba378d9ef766d8a2db195391be2371dc2.png

Reworked Submarine and Depth Upgrades
Major Update 2 introduces significant changes to how stations work. Previously, you could purchase CDs from the vending machine to upgrade your stations and increase maximum dive depth. This system has been completely reworked: CDs have been replaced by batteries, which can be found during expeditions. As such, think wisely about what to search for!  These batteries store energy that is used to power receivers (replacing the old PS5s). When a receiver is fully charged, you unlock the corresponding upgrade or gain access to the next depth level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/76b5e315c097c7676ab6715334de855580380d47.png

This new system presents divers with a crucial choice—invest in ship upgrades to make your expeditions safer and easier, or venture deeper for greater rewards and to "outdive" the Police closing in.

More Dangers Lurking Below
The legend of Atlantis speaks of an ancient creature—In the depths of Atlantis, a creature known as the Selfish Sun wanders, drawn to lights. It gathers brilliance into its hidden trove, casting shadows in its wake. Disturb its treasures, and you may awaken a blinding fury. Tread carefully: will you embrace the darkness or dare to reclaim the lost glow?

Pharma Corps' intelligence services have identified a new gadget in the Police’s arsenal—The Police Drone. This high-tech surveillance device is designed to monitor and track divers. Once you reach 2 or more stars, these drones will become active, scanning the area for any signs of trouble. If they spot you, they will attempt to escape and alert the authorities, escalating the situation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/4e43a38d02fc8010c5ca493b6a09e9e1d4099f6e.png

An Extended Wardrobe
Pharma Corps is excited to unveil five new diving suits—three Halloween-themed and two Atlantis-inspired designs. We know that style matters, even in the darkest depths, and we’re committed to giving divers more ways to express themselves. Dress to impress, no matter the mission!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/4ac0905695d52c0692418ebd3205b2dc78d1c213.png

Reworked End-game Report
We have implemented a new animated sequence where the Police bust in and arrest your team during a mission gone wrong. The scene then shifts to a mugshot lineup showing your whole crew in random poses, with your game stats clearly displayed. So, put on your best smile for the camera!—and remember, Pharma Corps will not be paying any bail so you better not get caught...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/d210ca10dc50ff0f34c31bb1b2ca741df8ad55f2.png

New Items
Pharma Corps' R&D team is excited to unveil our latest innovations! We’ve introduced two new modules: the Shell, boosting your health points to 200, and the CaptainMic, which allows communication with everyone, regardless of distance, and recharges automatically. 


Voice Chat Improvements

 Speaking indicator: now each skin has an element that lights up on the face when you are speaking to make it clearer for everyone
 Reworked Sound Attenuation system: walls now obstruct sound better
 Dead divers can hear each other better
 EMP voice effect volume is now lower


Improvements

 Some body parts are now still alive and move a bit (no change in gameplay)
 Collision in navigation now empties the net depending on damage
 Submarine net capacity depends on the submarine size (2: 2/4 slots, 4: 3/6, 8: 4/8)


If you’re still here, congratulations! Your dedication as a diver has not gone unnoticed by Pharma Corps. We appreciate your commitment to our mission. Remember, this second major update is packed with thrilling new features, and time is of the essence! So, gear up and dive into the depths—there’s no time to waste. Thank you for being an integral part of the Pharma Corps family!

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨Update 0.8 | 5-8 people submarine, new location & creature 🚨
notes.content:
Attention Recruits, 

We are presenting you the second part of our three-part update series. STAY TUNED for the final MAJOR chapter of our Halloween series coming October 28! 

This chapter brings, among other additions, one of the most requested features of Murky Divers. 

5-8 People Submarines
Pharma Corps noticed that some of you heavily requested the option to play with a vast amount of people. As they say, strength comes in numbers, and the fewer people we must report [strike]missing[/strike] taking a break, the happier our HR department will be. Therefore, we're introducing a new type of larger submarine suited to host up to 8 divers at the same time. Murky Divers now supports each player's preference: 

 1-2 people / Small submarine
 3-4 people / Medium submarine
 5-8 people / Large submarine

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/762e4eca063a04a48c65ddcaf54d8141f7a695b2.png

New Location
A couple of weeks ago, Pharma Corps introduced a new location The Black Market which was very well received. Believe it or not, our scouting team just picked up a new location on the sonar and received a cryptic message "A familiar signal pulses beneath the waves, but not all paths lead where you expect. In the silent deep, something watches—dare to approach, and you may return unchanged... or marked in ways unseen."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/c3044140627b8506183fc26a0682d2d479d23d39.png

New Creature
New creatures keep appearing during expeditions. This time one of Pharma Corps' most innovative experiments [strike]broke free[/strike] was released: The Crocsaw - part crocodile, part chainsaw. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/ceee9787a313a7c0fe2181308bf7928cbd22c321.png

Bugfixes

 Resolved vent collision issues
 Fixed a bug where players would respawn in unintended locations
 Corrected floating buttons that appeared during procedural generation
 Enemies can no longer attack through walls
 Fixed incorrect noise display in the 1-2 player submarine
 Spawn rate of dangerous Police entities in navigation is lower
 The submarine net now keeps its content after visiting the Black Market
 Fixed the disappearance of memes on sticky notes in submarines
 Fixed a bug that could softlock players in the shower in 1-2 player submarines
 Fixed player name sometimes not displaying correctly
 Fixed a crash caused by mines
 Fixed several bugs related to HUD, pop-ups, and menus


Recap of what has been added and what's still to come

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/505ac8583fabbd26a28cf3a369ca51803f618d81.jpg

STAY TUNED for the final MAJOR chapter of our Halloween series coming October 28! 

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨Update 0.7 | 1-2 player submarines are here 🚨
notes.content:
Attention Recruits, 

The spooky season is upon us. With Halloween just around the corner, we are presenting you the first of a three-part update series. Chapter One brings some heavily requested additions to Murky Divers.

One/Two Person Submarine
Pharma Corps noticed that some of you prefer the solitude of the ocean or the strength of a dynamic duo dive. Therefore, we're introducing a new type of smaller submarine suited to your dive-style preferences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/1187828091853ad64dce9e80eea9376970c861b2.png
Improved Onboarding
Our intelligence department witnessed some recruits struggling with the basic mechanics of operating the submarine and navigating to expedition sites. To solve this, we've improved our onboarding to enhance the ease of understanding the core loop:

 Redesign of stations and information displays for the sonar, narrow-band, net, collision display, lever, propulsor, torpedo launcher
 In-game tutorials with hints and conditional states to help guide players
 Overhaul of the submarine interior design
 Removed unnecessary information

New Creature
Last but not least, we added a new creature to the depths of Murky Divers: The Murderer. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/0e52f6a82b3e616e173757ec46f55797d936678f.png
Pricing and Roadmap
As announced in the previous update, the decision was made to set the price to $7.99 (regional pricing for different countries). Murky Divers has evolved significantly since its release: a new biome, more creatures, diving suits, locations such as the Black Market, new items and modules, and much more still to come. We even added an underwater scooter! In summary, Murky Divers has seen significant additions and improvements since its launch! 

Recap of what has been added and what's still to come
It all started out with our first major update bringing a ton of new things: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/89660118fec677fc49c5f2d41026723f13c1ef37.jpg

New biome: caves
New items: scooter, agent NUTS, bait
New stations: torpedo, laundry
Introducing swimming suits 
Controller support
Lots of smaller additions/improvements

Next up, we created this summarized roadmap of what followed after the first major update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45038801/37df6625e5d20e60d98f97d9477b891d588c1ddd.jpg

Update 0.7 is the first in a series of 3 updates leading to our Halloween special. Pharma Corps attaches a lot of importance to its seasonal events. Make sure to stay tuned for the festivities! 

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨Update 0.6 | Friday the 13th 🚨
notes.content:
Attention Recruits, 

Gifts given with care, yield great returns

Introducing The Trader, a mysterious figure operating the Black Market from a Sea Giant's belly. The Trader holds the key to a range of valuable items—if you can earn its favor.

But heed this warning: the stakes are high. Disturb the Trader's peace, and you’ll face consequences that even Pharma Corps can’t fix. Gift wisely, and you might find yourself equipped with the tools you need for your next mission.

Additions

New destination: Black Market. Reachable during navigation. Ducks are crucial.
New suit Nier Duckomata, buyable at the Black Market
Added a mirror inside the sub to check your best outfits

Improvements

Sound and microphone now still work when the game isn't in focus
Display name tags (togglable in settings)
Display object of collision when navigating
Added a fire button on the torpedo station
Better vision when carrying bulky items
Performance improvements

We would like to thank all of our loyal crew members for their continued support. Without you, we wouldn't be where we are today. 

Our goals with Murky Divers are far from complete but the game has evolved significantly over these past months with a large amount of new content (new biome, new monsters, diving suits, and many more). The decision was made to increase the base price from $5.99 to $7.99 on the 26th of September which brings us on par with the games in our niche. As such, make sure to grab your copy now! 

Pharma Corps has wild plans for its employees. More info coming (very) soon! 

All the best,
Pharma Corps Management

notes.title: 🚨Update 0.5 | The virus🚨
notes.content:

WE HAVE AN URGENT UPDATE FOR ALL DIVERS EMBARKING ON MISSIONS

It has come to our attention that a virus is spreading among our divers. This virus is highly contagious and can be transmitted through sneezing, vomiting, etc. in the vicinity of healthy recruits.

While we strongly advise against attempting to contract this virus, we must mention that those infected have reportedly enhanced their visual appearance. Pharma Corps is deeply concerned about the well-being of our divers, tread carefully!

Remember, the success of our operations depends on you. Stay vigilant, stay loyal, and continue to serve Pharma Corps with unwavering commitment.

notes.title: 🚨 Corporate Announcement: Major Update for Murky Divers coming soon!
notes.content:
Dear valued Crew Members,

We spent a lot of time monitoring your dives and community feedback. At Pharma Corps, the employee’s job satisfaction is one of the most important company values. 

Therefore, we directly solved two of your most important issues - GOING LIVE AT 18:00 CEST:

You can now enjoy:

 A save system keeping track of your well-earned progress
 A kick feature allowing you to get rid of that annoying employee who does not fit your crew’s moral values.


And now for the pièce de résistance… Announcing our Major Update #1

Pharma Corps thanks you for your dedication and bravery in navigating the depths of our underwater labs and is thrilled to announce the first major update coming July 19th, which will be packed with enhancements designed to elevate your experience and streamline your vital work in our underwater facilities.

Here’s what you can look forward to in this comprehensive update:

New Biome:
Leave the plain buildings behind and explore nature and the ocean. Find new ways to experience and handle your thalassophobia as you carry out your important work in our treacherous oceanic cave systems.

More Interactions:
Discover new methods of interacting with creatures—either luring or neutralizing them. Expect additional creatures to deal with and items to enhance your tasks.

Unlockables:
Earn in-game achievements to unlock a variety of new swimming suits, rewarding employees for their diligence and commitment to our objectives. Personalize your experience as you progress and achieve more.

Controller/Steam Deck Support:
Enjoy full controller support and optimized compatibility with the Steam Deck, ensuring you can perform your duties efficiently and comfortably, wherever you are.

-----

At Pharma Corps, we consider each of you an integral part of our family. Your commitment and hard work drive our success, and this update is a testament to our ongoing dedication to supporting you in every possible way.

We are grateful for your continued excellence and unwavering spirit. Together, we will ensure the integrity of our operations and keep unwanted attention at bay.

Warm regards,
Pharma Corps Management
